scenes.heading: Replication in Cloud Service
scenes.narration: Oak & Operations. Replication in Cloud Service. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What mechanism does AEM as a Cloud Service use to move content for replication?
scenes.heading: Sling Content Distribution to a pipeline service outside the AEM runtime
scenes.body: Section 11 says AEM as a Cloud Service uses Sling Content Distribution to move content to a pipeline service outside the AEM runtime.

scenes.question: What are the two predefined Cloud Service distribution agents and their default state?
scenes.heading: The publish agent is enabled by default, and the preview agent exists but is not enabled by default
scenes.body: Section 11 says there are two predefined agents: publish, which is enabled by default, and preview, which is not enabled by default.

scenes.question: Where are Cloud Service distribution agents monitored?
scenes.heading: Tools, Deployment, Distribution
scenes.body: The source says the publish and preview agents are monitored from Tools, Deployment, Distribution.

scenes.question: What is the recommended way to handle bulk publishing in Cloud Service?
scenes.heading: Use a workflow with the Tree Activation step
scenes.body: Section 11 says that for bulk publishing you should use a workflow with the Tree Activation step and that building your own bulk code is not recommended.

scenes.question: What happens when the Replication API is used without an agent filter?
scenes.heading: It uses only the agents enabled by default, which means publish
scenes.body: The source states that replicating without a filter uses only the agents enabled by default, which means the publish agent.

scenes.question: How do you target the preview tier with the Replication API?
scenes.heading: Pass ReplicationOptions with an AgentFilter
scenes.body: Section 11 explains that to target preview you pass ReplicationOptions with an AgentFilter.

scenes.question: What do the two Cloud Service agent queues mean?
scenes.heading: Persisted means the change is durably stored on the publish tier, and Fully published means it is live on all publish pods and Dispatcher cache has been cleared
scenes.body: The source says each Cloud Service agent shows two queues: Persisted for durable storage on the publish tier, and Fully published for content live on all publish pods with Dispatcher cache cleared for the paths.
